typography.strategy: A highly readable sans-serif for UI text, a strong grotesque for headers, and a monospace font for timestamps, IDs, and operational metrics. This creates an authoritative, data-first intelligence aesthetic without looking generic.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Build elevation with surface steps and subtle borders, not heavy drop shadows. Use a 1px solid stroke or 1px inner top border (border-t border-t-white/10) to separate panels. Dark mode is default and non-negotiable for this operational tool.
visual_enhancers.textures: Flat, matte finish. Avoid gradients and glossy effects entirely. The interface must look like a serious, industrial command center.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Slightly rounded corners (4px to 6px) to remain modern but professional.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Grid-disciplined layout. Emphasize a top row of 4–6 actionable metrics (KPI strip). Use strict, compact spacing (gap-4 or gap-6) for high data density.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar for desktop, bottom navigation for mobile.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use standard Tailwind scale but apply denser spacing (p-3 to p-5) inside cards to allow more information to be visible without scrolling.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align data arrays. Right-align numeric columns in tables. Never center-align primary structural elements.

component_strategy.cards: Dark charcoal background, border-white/10, no large blurry shadows.
component_strategy.buttons: Restrained use of primary gold/amber. Most actions should be outline or ghost buttons to maintain a calm, tactical UI. Primary button only for 'Next Best Action'.
component_strategy.tables: Dense rows, monospace IDs, distinct status badges. Subtle hover state on rows (bg-white/5).
component_strategy.status_badges: Small, pill-shaped or rectangular with slight background tint of the status color and bright text (e.g., bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20).
component_strategy.icons: Phosphor Icons (duotone or regular) or Lucide Icons for sharp, legible glyphs.

motion.transitions: Fast and decisive. Use 150ms ease-out. No bouncy or playful animations.
motion.interactions: Hover states should immediately brighten text or slightly lift background lightness (bg-white/5) to give immediate feedback without distraction.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against background meets at least AA standard. Monospace digits must be highly readable against their backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

media.logo_concept: Wordmark: BLOODHOUND in Cabinet Grotesk, all caps, wide tracking (tracking-widest). Icon: A minimalist, abstract geometric crosshair or radar blip in amber next to the text. It should feel like a piece of high-end intelligence software.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters carefully (12-24px blur) only for fixed elements like headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Missing image categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Palantir-meets-Linear operational dashboard. Maintain strict, dense grid alignments. Rely on typography and subtle background steps (not shadows) to create hierarchy. Keep it dark charcoal and use amber/gold strictly for primary actions. Use JetBrains Mono for all data digits. Do not invent facts—differentiate clearly between known and missing info. The interface must feel fast, decisive, and authoritative.
